API ReferenceBusiness Insights APIReportsList All Reports
List All Reports
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/bi/api/v1/report/all

List all the reports based on provided details.

reportType:

APPLICATION - For Application Reports
WORKPLACE - For Workplace Reports
DATA_EXPLORER - For Data Explorer Reports

subType helps to filter only certain types of reports. Default it's optional and pointing to "CustomDataFeed".

CustomDataFeed - For custom Apps list and download
ScheduledReports - For scheduled reports list and download
SaveAndSchedule - For data explorer save and schedule reports list and download
Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
reportType
string

Possible values: [APPLICATION, DATA_EXPLORER, WORKPLACE]

Type of report.

Default value: APPLICATION
subType
string

Possible values: [CustomDataFeed, ScheduledReports, SaveAndSchedule]

Subtype of report.

Default value: CustomDataFeed
startTime
int64

Report start time as Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch). If not provided or 0, defaults to midnight UTC of the 1st day of previous month.

endTime
int64

Report end time as Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch). If not provided or 0, defaults to the current time.

reportName
string

Filter by report name (optional).

Responses
​
200
400
401
405
429
500

Reports listed successfully.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
applicationCustomDataFeed
